responsibility: Defines the inference engine’s shared type-error reporting context and core diagnostic helpers, turning inference causes, traces, and partially resolved types into structured diagnostics while coordinating specialized submodules for region errors, missing type information, notes, and suggestions.
same_name_distinction: This is the main inference-reporting coordinator `mod.rs`: it defines `TypeErrCtxt` and the logic that turns inference traces, causes, and region/type failures into diagnostics, delegating to note/suggestion and region submodules. It differs from `errors/mod.rs`, which only defines reusable diagnostic structs, and from `traits/error_reporting/mod.rs`, which handles trait-specific failure reporting.
